result.summary: The page overall looks well-structured with only a minor inconsistency found in card styling within the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outline style while the same icon on the pizza card below has a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency between similar cards in the same list.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling (background and color) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
